103: Maintains a secure channel between this computer and the domain controller for authenticating users and services. If this service is stopped, the computer may not authenticate users and services and the domain controller cannot register DNS records. If this service is disabled, any services that explicitly depend on it will fail to start.
2002: Counters for measuring the performance of Netlogon.
2006: Number of thread currently waiting to acquire the semaphore.
2010: Number of thread currently holding the semaphore.
2014: The total number of times the semaphore has been acquired over the lifetime of the Secure Channel connection (or since system boot for _Total).
2018: The total number of times a thread has timed out waiting for the semaphore over the lifetime of the Secure Channel connection (or since system boot for _Total).
2022: The average amount of time the semaphore is held over the last sample.
2026: The base value used to calculate the average semaphore hold time.
2030: How long, in milliseconds, the last successful NTLM authentication took.
2034: The base value used to calculate Last Authentication Time.
3002: Counters for monitoring DC location functionality. These counters are only supported on domain-joined machines.
3006: Number of successful DC locator requests per second.
3010: Number of failed DC locator requests per second.
3014: Number of currently active DC locator requests.
3018: Average latency of successful requests in seconds.
3022: The base value used to calculate average success latency.
3026: Average latency of failed requests in seconds.
3030: The base value used to calculate average failure latency.
3034: Number of DC locator cache hits per second.
3038: Number of DC locator cache misses per second.
3042: Number of PDC-required DC locator requests per second. Corresponds to the DS_PDC_REQUIRED flag of the DsGetDcName api. Note that a single request may specify multiple flags.
3046: Number of writable-required DC locator requests per second. Corresponds to the DS_WRITABLE_REQUIRED flag of the DsGetDcName api. Note that a single request may specify multiple flags.
3050: Number of force-required (cache-bypass) DC locator requests per second. Corresponds to the DS_FORCE_REDISCOVERY flag of the DsGetDcName api. Note that a single request may specify multiple flags.
3054: Number of excess DC locator requests rejected per second.
3058: Number of LDAP UDP pings sent per second.
3062: Number of mailslot pings sent per second.
3066: Number of UDP ports currently opened by DC locator.
3070: Number of DNS query failures per second.
3074: Number of KDC-required DC locator requests per second. Corresponds to the DS_KDC_REQUIRED flag of the DsGetDcName api. Note that a single request may specify multiple flags.
3078: Number of GC-required DC locator requests per second. Corresponds to the DS_GC_REQUIRED flag of the DsGetDcName api. Note that a single request may specify multiple flags.
3082: Number of time-server-required DC locator requests per second. Corresponds to the DS_TIMESERV_REQUIRED flag of the DsGetDcName api. Note that a single request may specify multiple flags.
3086: Number of DS-required (Windows 2000 or higher) DC locator requests per second. Corresponds to the DS_DIRECTORY_SERVICE_REQUIRED flag of the DsGetDcName api. Note that a single request may specify multiple flags.
3090: Number of DS-required (Windows 2008 or higher) DC locator requests per second. Corresponds to the DS_DIRECTORY_SERVICE_6_REQUIRED flag of the DsGetDcName api. Note that a single request may specify multiple flags.
3094: Number of DS-required (Windows 2012 or higher) DC locator requests per second. Corresponds to the DS_DIRECTORY_SERVICE_8_REQUIRED flag of the DsGetDcName api. Note that a single request may specify multiple flags.
3098: Number of DS-required (Windows 2012 R2 or higher) DC locator requests per second. Corresponds to the DS_DIRECTORY_SERVICE_9_REQUIRED flag of the DsGetDcName api. Note that a single request may specify multiple flags.
3102: Number of DS-required (Windows 2016 or higher) DC locator requests per second. Corresponds to the DS_DIRECTORY_SERVICE_10_REQUIRED flag of the DsGetDcName api. Note that a single request may specify multiple flags.
3106: Number of try-next-closest-site DC locator requests per second. Corresponds to the DS_TRY_NEXTCLOSEST_SITE flag of the DsGetDcName api. Note that a single request may specify multiple flags.
3110: Number of KeyList-support-required DC locator requests per second. Corresponds to the DS_KEY_LIST_SUPPORT_REQUIRED flag of the DsGetDcName api. Note that a single request may specify multiple flags.
4002: Counters for monitoring DC locator ping performance on domain controllers.
4006: Number of UDP LDAP pings currently being processed.
4010: Number of UDP LDAP pings received per second.
4012: Pings: Average UDP LDAP Ping Latency (secs)
4013: Pings: Average UDP LDAP Ping Latency (secs)
4014: Average latency of UDP LDAP ping processing times in seconds.
4016: Average UDP LDAP ping latency Base
4017: Average UDP LDAP ping latency Base
4018: The base value used to calculate average UDP LDAP ping latency.
4022: Number of mailslot pings currently being processed.
4026: Number of mailslot pings received per second.
4030: Average latency of mailslot ping processing times.
4034: The base value used to calculate average mailslot ping latency.
